newsitem.title: USA: Chino copper mine talks continue, no agreement.
newsitem.headline: Chino copper mine talks continue, no agreement.

text.p: Talks between Phelps Dodge Corp and the United Steelworkers of America union about renewing a labor pact at the Chino copper mine in New Mexico, continued Friday but no agreement appeared in sight, the company said.
"The talks are still continuing but they are uneventful," Phelps Dodge's Treasurer, Tom Foster said.
USWA officials were not immediately available for comment.
Foster reiterated that the final labor deal on offer by the company was not up for negotiation, and should be put before the employees for a vote.
The stalled labor talks began Thursday in Las Cruces and were scheduled to end Friday.
"I don't expect any news to come out of it," Foster said.
The Chino mine, where workers have been without a labor contract since June 30 last year, was operating "perfectly normally," Foster said.
